video_title: Tyrese Haliburton on Hosting Charity Softball Game, Excitement for Season & More

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the Pacers and Colts' strong relationship
quotes.excerpt: We're very thankful that the Pacers and the Colts have a great relationship
quotes.quote: Honestly, I'd be lying if I said I did a lot of the legwork. We're very thankful that the Pacers and the Colts have a great relationship and they were able to smooth things over between the organizations and make it work. That's special. I know the fever in the middle of the season, they won't be playing, but for any of them to be here is special too. It's just fun for everybody.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his baseball skills and team competitiveness
quotes.excerpt: I haven't swung a baseball bat in at least five years
quotes.quote: They're rough. I haven't swung a baseball bat in at least five years, so they got me batting first person, so that's setting the tone. Either my team's going to be nice or whack, I don't know. We're going to see when I get up.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on his recovery and relationship with Daniel Theis
quotes.excerpt: Obviously we have the same surgeons, so it's interesting
quotes.quote: We talked a good amount. Obviously we have the same surgeons, so it's interesting. His is very much so closer to now than I did, and he's coming back earlier, it's just how the schedule worked out. So I'm really excited to see how everything pans out for him and I know he's going to do great and I'm really excited that he's back and I know the city is as well. We've had a few conversations, I'll be an ear as much as I can, so we've had some great combos.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the recovery process for Achilles injuries
quotes.excerpt: There's a big difference from like nine to 12, 12 to 15
quotes.quote: It's funny with the Achilles, the recovery, there's a big difference from like nine to 12, 12 to 15. That's what I heard from everybody. And even I, at nine months, I felt like, hey, I could probably play, but where I feel now is completely different than I did nine months ago. So he doesn't necessarily have the benefit of that nine months now, but I'm very curious to see how he feels in three months. There's less movement in his position than what I do running more, but I'm excited to see. I know he's going to be great and I know he's going to do awesome.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the competitive landscape of the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: Excited for LeBron to be in the East, excited for the reigning champs are in the East
quotes.quote: It's exciting. Competition is fun. Excited for LeBron to be in the East, excited for the reigning champs are in the East. There's a lot of excitement in our conference and that makes it special, that makes it more fun.
